question: In the fixed-epoch strongly filtered k->0 limit of the completed-U1 preferred-coordinate constraints, does finite B determine its leading value at O(k^0), or do the leading constraints reduce exactly to the known comoving-source regularity condition so that B first appears at O(k^2)?

scope.limit: x=k^2->0 at fixed a>0 and finite M_c>0, so a1_eff=O(x)
scope.domain: lambda_HL>1 with r=lambda_HL-1>0 and D=3lambda_HL-1=2+3r; E_th>0
scope.sources: preferred-coordinate total delta_mu_pref and q_pref plus ordinary A source; all admit regular even-power x expansions

acceptance: write momentum as -r x B=N(x), N=Q-D(psi_prime+H phi), Q=3a q_pref; finite B requires N0=0
take the O(x^0) Hamiltonian equation, where r E_th L and Pcal L psi vanish, and combine it with N0=0
using D-2=3r prove exactly that a^2 delta_mu_pref,0+H Q0=0
show this is equivalent to 3a^2 delta_mu_pref,0+9Ha q_pref,0=0, the leading comoving-source regularity condition already identified in C10.25/C10.50
therefore prove the leading finite-B condition supplies no independent equation for B0
expand N(x)=x N2+O(x^2) and prove B0=-N2/r; hence the first finite value of B is determined only by the O(k^2) coefficient of the full adiabatic source/metric gradient expansion
machine-check the algebraic residuals exactly and emit an immutable certificate
do not infer B0=0 and do not use an arbitrary detached Newtonian chi seed
next_if_pass: derive the physical O(k^2) preferred adiabatic gradient expansion for the baseline species set (baryons, photons, massless relativistic species, neutral RTK/Khronon), then evaluate B0=-N2/r and transform the projected seed to the Newtonian Boltzmann variables.
non_claims: does not yet calculate N2 or B0
does not include massive-neutrino anisotropic stress
does not implement completed-U1 CLASS feedback
does not provide spectra or likelihood evidence
